items.html: And this is the matter of the exile of Babylon of seventy years, opposite these seven lights, which are seven aspects, each one included of ten; therefore it is called the exile of Babylon, which is the Gematria of DL (34), as is known — for Malchut is built through Bochu (BUKHV), the reverse of Ehyeh, which is the Gematria of 34. And then the measure of the stature of Malchut is the length of the curtain of thirty cubits and the breadth of four cubits, the count of 34. And now her building and her first stature, which is the Gematria of 34, was diminished.
